# 0/1 — The First Orientation

## #0

The word *rain* appears on the page. Its letters can be counted, its meaning questioned, its use corrected. The appearance is already present to someone undertaking those acts. Another word can name that presence, and a further account can describe how the reader encounters the page. Each joins what is given. The presence through which the account is encountered remains involved in the encounter it describes.

**`0/1` holds this conscious circumstance in its first orientation: the singular One becomes articulate through the polyvalent All.** This is the root Symbolon relation. Its `0` names unobjectifiable awareness; its `1` names appearing, the field of determinate differences. The slash carries the differentiating activity through which they are distinguishable within one event. Awareness is encountered through appearing, and appearing is present in awareness. This is already the relation in which the word can be read, before the reader gives it a theory.

The [parent slash](the-slash.md) **grounds** the first orientation as `/ = −/−`: relation before the terms have acquired their distinct names. In `0/1`, the relation has become the circumstance of an appearance. The slash makes this giving legible within the event itself. [The core theorem spine](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **sources** this native derivation. Its further determinations unfold the circumstance already present here.

## #1

The two sides have different kinds of unity. `0` is singular because it cannot be divided out as one more item among the things it lets appear. A thought about awareness is determinate; awareness as the condition of that thought's appearing has not thereby been added to the inventory. `1` is one as an articulated field: the word, its letters, the difference between this word and another, the page, the reading, and the relations through which each becomes available. The first mark already opens plurality. To determine even one thing is to let distinctions become possible within and around it.

This is why the two ones are **One and All**. The singular One does not become more singular when appearances are removed, and the All does not reach completeness by accumulating enough isolated items. An inventory itself requires discrimination, relation and someone for whom its items count. Those activities belong to the whole it tries to enumerate. The authorial [Mono–Poly manuscript](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones.md) **sources** this exact asymmetry; [A11, The Two Ones](../section-rooms/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **grounds** its developed argument. Calling the sides only “ground” and “mark” would leave out what gives those names their force: the ground's unobjectifiable singleness and the mark's already relational multiplicity.

The broken halves of a symbolon give the relation an image. A fit can be recognised only while the halves retain the edges through which they fit. Each half carries the relation in its own contour; neither carries the other as its private content. Here the image **figures** the One/All relation: distinction makes belonging perceptible. The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field](episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** this use as operational homology; its historical branch carries the separate lexical work. The root operation does not depend on claiming that the two poles of awareness are physical pieces of a broken object.

## #2

The first mark has an edge. A word means through differences from other words; a count admits something as one by deciding what belongs to that one. Exclusion participates in the appearance's positive identity. [A08, Constitutive Exclusion](../section-rooms/arguments/A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) **qualifies** determination at this edge: what is excluded remains implicated in what the determination means. In `0/1`, the slash retains the activity by which the edge was drawn. Its products stay related through the differentiation that made them readable.

The direction of dependence is consequently exact. `1` depends on `0` for being present at all. `0` depends on `1` for manifestation, articulation and knowability. These respects cannot be exchanged. A description makes awareness available to discussion; it does not manufacture the awareness in which that description is encountered. Equally, awareness's singleness cannot be encountered by stripping away every possible form of encounter and then inspecting what remains. The [order-of-dependence argument](../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **grounds** this asymmetry. Its order is constitutive; a chronology of first awareness and then appearance would already require the field in which before and after appear.

The distinction allows a positive account to be exact. “Rain has four letters” determines something checkable. Its finite scope gives the assertion its office. The assertion loses fidelity if that office is promoted into possession of the whole circumstance that makes counting possible. [A01, Faithful Definition](../section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **tests** the difference through an actual defining act: determination can disclose its own condition while remaining a determination. `0/1` gives this fidelity its first orientation—the condition becomes expressible, and the expression carries its dependence within what it says.

## #3

Once expressed, the relation can turn upon its own expression. The two digits, `0` and `1`, remain available singly. If each of two places can receive either digit, the pairings are `00`, `01`, `10` and `11`. There are four because the first place has two possibilities and, for each, the second has two. Keeping these four pairings together with the original two singles gives the binary and the binary of the binary:

$$2 + 2^2 = 2 + 4 = 6.$$

The count is the first explicit `4+2`: four relational forms and the two single terms through which their differences can be written. The pairings do not replace the singles; they expose what happens when the distinction becomes available to its own operation. The [self-identity root](self-identity.md) **extends** this hinge through the identifying activity, and the [housed Binary Explication](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) **sources** the further formal articulation in its definition and process files.

The root relation therefore contains more than a static opposition of two signs. It can differentiate, take up its differentiation, and make that taking-up available in turn. Each further expression is still a mark present through the relation it expresses. This is the force of the slash as AND/OR in the authorial derivation: the two remain together and discriminable, and the operation can be read from either side. [A02, the copula](../section-rooms/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) **grounds** the identification through difference that permits such a reading. The repeatable letter and the present act of identifying it have related, distinct offices.

## #4

This self-relation is at work in the original circumstance. A reader asks what a word means; the question already takes something as sufficiently determinate to ask about. An answer commits that determination to an account. In the native field this is `?/!`, the movement into answerability that the [question/assertion root](question-assertion.md) **extends** directly from `0/1`. The mark then acquires force through withdrawal and extension, becomes recognisable in recurrence, enters the personed relation of saying and being addressed, and opens onto an exact local difference whose horizon it cannot contain. These are the distinct operations of `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS` and `∞/dx`.

[A18, the complete eight-determination argument](../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** their ordered traversal. This first orientation remains implicated through all of it. A question, a force, a pattern, a personed utterance and a local differential are each determinate appearances; none abolishes the singular condition through which it becomes present. Their differences make the same relation increasingly articulate. `X/x`, for example, gives determining capacity and its indefinite particular one letter in two cases. Its particular can recur and vary; the capacity is made legible through those instances without becoming an additional instance beside them.

A technical account enters on the articulated side of this relation. Its sources, permissions, memory and transformations can be exposed and tested. [A01′, Faithful Definition of the Agent](../section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A01-prime-Faithful-Definition-of-the-Agent.md) **tests** the root's demand at that grain by keeping the determining assemblage inside the account of the agent. Such disclosure makes the account more answerable. The phenomenal question has its own object: whether that artificial configuration is a locus of experience. A system's production of a first-person sentence is a determinate content, so its production alone settles neither the presence nor the absence of that locus. The root's positive first-person relation and the Open localisation question retain their distinct force.

## #5→0

The expression now turns toward what its own articulation presupposes. This is `1/0`: the achieved mark read through its condition. The [return orientation](1-0.md) **extends** the same relation from the other end. Returning does not require the mark to disappear. The word can remain the same word while the reader recognises more of what was involved in saying, hearing or counting it. What changes is the claim the account makes upon its own source.

The notation preserves a precise mathematical pressure. Ordinary arithmetic evaluates `0/1` as zero and leaves division by zero undefined. QL's equality `0/1 = 1/0` concerns the identity of the relation under reversed orientation. It does not assign the two arithmetic expressions an equal numerical value. The [Matheme register](matheme/README.md) **qualifies** the passage into formal operation by preserving that boundary and the distinct definitional and processual chains. Here the asymmetry lets manifestation become definite while preventing the return from closing around an object called its ground.

The recognition gives further determination a place to begin. In the [trust argument](../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md), which **extends** this return into lived reliance, a finite account can be used, corrected, withdrawn and renewed. Trust names the lived reliance already active in the first relation: perception, memory and language depend before their accounts can certify that dependence. The One/All distinction gives its two offices without exhausting what it means to entrust oneself. The common pressure is that the achieved account remains answerable to an encounter it cannot manufacture from its own contents.

This root **returns-to** [The Loan Returns, §1 · #5→0](../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/18-s1-p5-loan-returns.md), where the essay brings the sign's mathematical achievement into the relation it discloses. It also **presages** [A36, Advent of Integral Zero](../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md): the exact sign remains, bearing the passage through its determinations. The returned `0/1` contains that achieved articulation. A further word can now be spoken from a circumstance whose dependence has become more legible.
